title: COLMAP reconstruction tutorial
use: Explains sparse structure from motion and dense reconstruction from overlapping photographs.
limit: Use for multi-view recovery; metric scale and independent dimensions still need external references.

title: Meshroom capture guide
use: Practical photography guidance: coverage, diffuse lighting, stable focal length, and turntable backgrounds.
limit: Versioned manual; image overlap is guidance, not a dimensional-accuracy guarantee.

title: COLMAP installation and build options
use: Check supported builds, compute backends, and dependencies before choosing a reconstruction setup.
limit: Read the instructions for the chosen release; no local installation was performed.

title: OpenCV camera calibration
use: Camera intrinsics, lens distortion, and undistortion using calibration targets.
limit: Calibration residuals do not by themselves establish object-space accuracy.

title: OpenCV homography tutorial
use: Projective mapping and perspective correction for a plane.
limit: A single plane correction cannot recover arbitrary 3D depth.

title: fSpy camera matching
use: Recover a useful camera match for interpreting perspective in one still image.
limit: Camera matching does not reveal hidden shape or establish all dimensions.

title: FreeCAD: importing and scaling reference images
use: Import a reference image and calibrate it using a known distance.
limit: Use coplanar measurement references; retain measured dimensions separately.

title: FreeCAD TechDraw workbench
use: Create drawing views, dimensions, sections, annotations, and PDF/SVG/DXF exports from 3D models.
limit: A drawing conveys design intent only when datums, dimensions, and inspection requirements are chosen.

title: FreeCAD traditional 2D drafting manual
use: Introduces Draft as a bridge between 2D geometry and 3D modeling.
limit: Use Sketcher for constrained profiles and TechDraw for model-derived drawings.

title: Fusion canvas calibration concepts
use: Explains canvas size and calibration in Fusion.
limit: License and platform requirements must be checked separately.

title: Fusion: convert a mesh to a solid
use: Describes faceted and prismatic mesh conversions and their timeline options.
limit: Conversion is not proof of recovered original feature history; availability can depend on entitlement.

title: Autodesk University: reverse engineering with imported data
use: Long-form training on mesh, canvas, and imported-data workflows.
limit: Older course; use current documentation for interface and licensing details.

title: McNeel reverse engineering guide
use: Orientation to reconstructing editable surfaces from mesh or point-cloud measurements.
limit: Some linked examples are historical; distinguish surface reconstruction from mesh wrapping.

title: Rhino ShrinkWrap
use: Constructs a watertight mesh around several geometry types.
limit: Wrapping can alter gaps, cavities, and small features; inspect deviations afterward.

title: CadQuery documentation
use: Python-based parametric CAD with engineering export formats.
limit: A modeling tool, not an automatic photograph measurement system.

title: build123d documentation
use: Python parametric B-rep modeling based on Open Cascade.
limit: Pin a release when reproducing examples; latest documentation can describe development code.

title: OpenSCAD documentation
use: Scripted constructive geometry, extrusion, and reusable dimensions.
limit: Keep the script as editable source; mesh export is not a feature-history CAD exchange.

title: Inkscape: tracing an image
use: Turn bitmap silhouettes into vector paths for cleaned-up profiles and extrusion.
limit: Trace results need scale, node simplification, and closed-loop checks.

title: MeshLab project and capabilities
use: Mesh cleaning, inspection, healing, simplification, and conversion.
limit: Smoothing and decimation can remove dimensional features.

title: CloudCompare distance computation
use: Explains cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-mesh comparison.
limit: Nearest-neighbor distance depends on sampling; alignment and reference quality matter.

title: Open3D ICP registration tutorial
use: Refine alignment from an initial approximate transform.
limit: A plausible local alignment can still be incorrect, especially for repeated or symmetric shapes.

title: Open3D surface reconstruction
use: Alpha shapes, ball pivoting, and Poisson reconstruction from point clouds.
limit: Normals, sampling, and low-support regions influence the resulting mesh.

title: CGAL shape detection
use: Primitive detection and region growing for point sets and meshes.
limit: Detected primitives are hypotheses that need tolerance and coverage checks.

title: CGAL polygon mesh processing
use: Mesh geometry, repair, remeshing, intersections, and distance tools.
limit: Check the license of the particular CGAL packages used.

title: MIT Shape Interrogation hyperbook
use: Mathematical reference for curves, surfaces, NURBS, intersections, curvature, and offsets.
limit: Study selectively after learning vectors, calculus, and parametric curves.

title: Keenan Crane: Discrete Differential Geometry
use: Develops computational surface geometry and geometric operators.
limit: Foundational material; not an end-to-end CAD conversion recipe.

title: Hartley and Zisserman: Multiple View Geometry
use: Sample chapters and supporting material for projective and multi-view geometry.
limit: The landing page provides selected resources, not necessarily the full book.

title: libigl tutorial
use: Hands-on geometry processing and differential operators.
limit: Programmer-oriented; component licenses should be read before redistribution.

title: Geometry Central
use: Surface mesh data structures and geometry-processing algorithms.
limit: Useful for custom tools; not a desktop reverse-engineering workflow by itself.

title: Prusa: modeling with 3D printing in mind
use: Design constraints for walls, overhangs, orientation, and fitting parts.
limit: No universal clearance; validate the printer, material, and orientation actually used.

title: Prusa: layers and perimeters
use: Connects shell and layer settings with printable geometry.
limit: Slicer settings and extrusion width affect thin-wall outcomes.

title: Blender 3D Print Toolbox extension
use: Tools for mesh checks, volume, wall work, orientation, and print preparation.
limit: An automated mesh check cannot validate mechanical fit or load capacity.

title: 3MF specification directory
use: Authoritative entry point to 3MF core and extension specifications.
limit: Check which extensions the exporter and slicer actually support.

title: 3MF Core Specification source
use: Detailed model, mesh, coordinate, and packaging requirements.
limit: A 3MF project from a slicer may also contain vendor-specific settings.

title: NIST additive manufacturing test artifact
use: Feature-based evaluation of additive manufacturing geometry.
limit: The test concept transfers; published system results are not predictions for a hobby printer.

title: NIH 3D
use: Discover biomedical and scientific 3D models and workflows.
limit: Read each entry's provenance, units, version, and permitted uses.

title: NIH 3D FAQs
use: Model use, citation, and platform guidance.
limit: A repository entry is not automatic clinical or manufacturing approval.

title: MorphoSource repository description
use: Biological, fossil, and cultural-object 3D, 2D, and audiovisual data platform.
limit: The live catalog blocked automated access; individual datasets and permissions were not inspected.

title: Smithsonian 3D digitization program
use: Object capture, research, access, and collection digitization.
limit: Verify the license and available download on each collection record.

title: Smithsonian photogrammetry and 3D technologies
use: Introduces image-based digitization in conservation.
limit: Conservation workflows may prioritize visual recording over engineering fit.

title: 3D Slicer image segmentation
use: Delineate structures in image volumes before surface extraction.
limit: CT/MRI slice stacks are a different input problem from exterior photographs.

title: 3D Slicer segmentations and export
use: Segmentation representations and creating surfaces for printing.
limit: Voxel spacing, threshold choices, and smoothing affect final geometry.

title: 3D Slicer training compendium
use: Guided exercises with sample data.
limit: Use sample datasets for learning; do not infer clinical fitness from an export.

title: Stanford 3D scanning repository
use: Classic range-scan and mesh data for registration and reconstruction practice.
limit: These are scanner datasets, not evidence of phone-photogrammetry accuracy.

title: Structure-from-Motion Revisited
use: Schönberger and Frahm, CVPR 2016: foundation for the COLMAP reconstruction pipeline.
limit: Search-index abstract checked; direct page fetch returned 403.

title: DeepCAD author project page
use: Wu, Xiao, and Zheng, ICCV 2021: generative modeling of CAD operation sequences.
limit: Research on CAD representation and generation is not a dimensional photo-conversion guarantee.

title: BrepGen paper
use: Xu and collaborators, SIGGRAPH 2024: B-rep generation with structured latent geometry.
limit: Generation of valid geometry and recovery of the exact observed part are different tasks.

title: Photogrammetry-derived printed sheep scapula comparison
use: An anatomy example comparing models made with PLA and TPU.
limit: Single study and application; no general phone accuracy or material equivalence is inferred.

title: Optical face scanner for customized 3D-printed spectacles
use: A related application linking anatomical surface capture with customized printed products.
limit: Title and identifiers checked through Entrez; abstract and full methods were not reviewed.

title: colmap/colmap
use: Sparse and dense reconstruction from photographs.
limit: Inspect the installed build for supported compute backends.

title: FreeCAD/FreeCAD
use: Editable mechanical CAD and model-derived drawings.
limit: Build constraints from measured features; importing a mesh alone does not restore intent.

title: CloudCompare/CloudCompare
use: Point-cloud registration and deviation inspection.
limit: Compare against an independent, appropriately aligned reference.

title: alicevision/Meshroom
use: Graph-based reconstruction workflows in the AliceVision ecosystem.
limit: Pipeline and GPU requirements vary by release; inspect current setup instructions.

title: cnr-isti-vclab/meshlab
use: Interactive processing of scanned triangle meshes.
limit: Retain a raw copy before smoothing, repair, or decimation.

title: cdcseacave/openMVS
use: Dense reconstruction and meshing tools.
limit: Inspect the chosen pipeline's required camera/scene inputs.

title: gumyr/build123d
use: Python-based CAD construction.
limit: Pin dependencies for repeatable model generation.

title: openscad/openscad
use: Scripted constructive-solid models.
limit: Use native source for editability; do not equate STL with feature history.

title: isl-org/Open3D
use: Programmable processing of point clouds and meshes.
limit: Library outputs need coordinate, unit, and quality checks.

title: JCGM 100:2008 Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement (GUM)
use: Defines standard uncertainty and Type B evaluation, including the bounded rectangular case where a quantity known only within ±a has standard uncertainty a/√3.
limit: A rounding interval or published bound is one input. The guide does not supply perspective, distortion, picking, or manufacturing errors for an image-based measurement.

title: CadQuery/cadquery
use: Parametric CAD as Python code.
limit: Photo interpretation and measurement remain upstream tasks.

title: libigl/libigl
use: Geometry-processing algorithms and experiments.
limit: API license metadata differs from project description; inspect component licenses.

title: mikedh/trimesh
use: Mesh loading, analysis, transformations, and export.
limit: Watertightness is only one acceptance criterion.

title: CGAL/cgal
use: Computational geometry primitives and mesh algorithms.
limit: Licensing varies among packages; review selected modules.

title: microsoft/TRELLIS
use: Image-conditioned 3D asset generation research.
limit: Generated unseen surfaces are hypotheses; inspect weights and dependency terms separately.

title: rundiwu/DeepCAD
use: Implementation accompanying the DeepCAD research paper.
limit: Research code; repository metadata reports its last push in 2024.

title: sxyu/sdf
use: Convert a triangle mesh into a continuous signed distance representation.
limit: This direction is mesh to distance field, not photograph to CAD.

title: prusa3d/PrusaSlicer
use: Slicing and toolpath preview.
limit: Recheck the selected printer profile and resulting dimensions.

title: OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer
use: Slicing and calibration workflows.
limit: A successful slice does not establish physical fit or strength.

title: PrusaSlicer cut tool with connectors
use: Cuts a model into parts and generates plug, dowel, or snap connectors for reassembly.
limit: The article is filed under a legacy slicer release; check the current version, and test connector fit with a coupon in the intended material.

title: Formlabs: hollowing models and adding drain holes
use: Walks through orienting, hollowing, and adding drain holes so resin can escape and cupping is avoided, including adding at least one extra drain hole.
limit: Vendor workflow for its own software and printers; wall thickness, hole size, and orientation must be validated for the actual resin and machine.

title: glTF 2.0 specification
use: Defines the glTF coordinate system and units: right-handed, +Y up, +Z forward, and linear distances in metres.
limit: Many CAD and slicing tools present Z-up millimetres; convert explicitly on import and check extents rather than trusting a viewer.

title: Blender manual: posing armatures

limit: Re-posing a dense sculpt needs skin weights and joint cleanup; a convincing on-screen pose still needs wall, support, and contact checks.

title: Blender manual: sculpting
use: Brush-based Sculpt Mode for shaping over a blockout and repairing deformation after posing.
limit: Sculpted surfaces are design interpretation; measured interfaces should remain parametric and be joined afterward.

title: Creative Commons license types
use: Summarizes common license elements (attribution, non-commercial, no derivatives, share-alike) that govern many shared models and images.
limit: Marketplace and custom licenses differ from Creative Commons; read the terms attached to each asset. Character and trademark rights can apply regardless of the file license.

title: nerfstudio-project/nerfstudio
use: Neural rendering research and reconstruction tooling.
limit: View-synthesis quality and recovered surface accuracy must be tested separately.

title: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2
use: Image-to-3D shape and texture generation research.
limit: Inspect model-specific terms and hardware requirements before use.

title: samxuxiang/BrepGen

limit: Research generation method, not an assured photo-measurement product.

use: Research on recovering CAD sequences from product images (2026).

title: RealCAD: Towards Real-World Image-to-CAD Reconstruction under Domain Shift and Parameter Bias
use: Research on synthetic-to-real domain shift and CAD parameter bias (2026).
limit: Discovery lead only; do not treat a search abstract as independent validation.
